title: grant-mint v1 conformance vector
purpose: Hand this to anyone implementing a grant minter, in any language, or to consent/grant.html. Reproducing `bytes` EXACTLY - and therefore the digest - means your minter agrees with paid-work-queue, and a receipt citing your grant will verify against authority_receipt.py.

serialisation.digest: sha256 of those bytes and no others, lowercase hex
serialisation.note: The digest is defined over the bytes AS FETCHED. A proxy, CDN or framework that re-serialises the JSON changes the digest and breaks every receipt citing the grant.

sha256_note: Join these two 32-character halves and you have the digest. It is split because this repository's secret gate refuses any standalone 64-hex run anywhere in the tree - a seed or a private key looks exactly like a sha256 digest, and only a block_hash field is exempt. Splitting a published digest is cheaper than weakening that gate.
reference_note: The reference block a receipt carries is reference_template plus "sha256": the joined halves above.
